definitions.explanation: The act of refraining from something out of politeness or consideration.
Politely refusing or abstaining from something.

examples.japanese: ご{遠慮|えんりょ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: Please don't hold back. / Please help yourself.

examples.japanese: {遠慮|えんりょ}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦タバコ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご{遠慮|えんりょ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠慮|えんりょ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おきます→置く：01092_oku⟧。
⟦せっかく→折角：04361_sekkaku⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠慮|えんりょ}⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for the offer, but I'll have to decline today.

notes:
{遠慮|えんりょ} expresses the Japanese cultural concept of holding back out of politeness or consideration.

Verb usage: {遠慮|えんりょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to hold back, to refrain, to decline

Common expressions:
- ⟦ご→ご：02138_go⟧{遠慮|えんりょ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without holding back, feel free
- ⟦ご→ご：02138_go⟧{遠慮|えんりょ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please refrain (polite prohibition)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: I'll decline (polite refusal)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧: don't hold back

Cultural note: {遠慮|えんりょ} reflects the Japanese value of being considerate and not imposing on others. Over-eating, speaking too much, or asking for favors without {遠慮|えんりょ} can be seen as impolite.
